# Runs as SYSTEM during the specialize pass. Rule: lightest Windows that still runs Valorant. # Never touch Secure Boot, TPM, VBS/HVCI, Defender or Windows Update: Vanguard checks them. $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' Start-Transcript -Path "$env:windir\Setup\Scripts\Specialize.log"
# Edge downloads Riot Client and the NVIDIA driver. Windows Security shows Memory Integrity. # DesktopAppInstaller cannot be removed on 26300. The rest are frameworks. $keep = 'Microsoft.MicrosoftEdge', 'Microsoft.SecHealthUI', 'Microsoft.WindowsNotepad', 'Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller', 'Microsoft.VCLibs', 'Microsoft.UI.Xaml', 'Microsoft.NET.Native', 'Microsoft.WindowsAppRuntime' Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online | Where-Object { $name = $_.DisplayName -not ($keep | Where-Object { $name -like "$_*" }) } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "remove appx $($_.DisplayName)" Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -PackageName $_.PackageName | Out-Null }
$capabilities = 'App.StepsRecorder', 'Browser.InternetExplorer', 'Hello.Face', 'MathRecognizer', 'Media.WindowsMediaPlayer', 'Microsoft.Wallpapers.Extended', 'Microsoft.Windows.PowerShell.ISE', 'Microsoft.Windows.WordPad', 'OneCoreUAP.OneSync', 'OpenSSH.Client', 'Print.Fax.Scan', 'Print.Management.Console', 'VBSCRIPT' Get-WindowsCapability -Online | Where-Object { $name = $_.Name $_.State -eq 'Installed' -and ($capabilities | Where-Object { $name -like "$_*" }) } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "remove capability $($_.Name)" Remove-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $_.Name | Out-Null } Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
function Set-Dword($path, $name, $value) { # New-Item -Force on an existing key wipes it, so only create missing keys. if (-not (Test-Path $path)) { New-Item -Path $path -Force | Out-Null } Set-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name $name -Value $value -Type DWord -Force } $pol = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft' Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\DataCollection" AllowTelemetry 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\CloudContent" DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\CloudContent" DisableCloudOptimizedContent 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\CloudContent" DisableConsumerAccountStateContent 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Dsh" AllowNewsAndInterests 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\WindowsCopilot" TurnOffWindowsCopilot 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\WindowsAI" DisableAIDataAnalysis 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\WindowsAI" AllowRecallEnablement 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\Explorer" DisableSearchBoxSuggestions 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\Windows Search" AllowCortana 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\Windows Search" DisableWebSearch 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\Windows Search" ConnectedSearchUseWeb 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\AdvertisingInfo" DisabledByGroupPolicy 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\GameDVR" AllowGameDVR 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" Disabled 1 Set-Dword "$pol\Windows\DeliveryOptimization" DODownloadMode 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Edge" StartupBoostEnabled 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Edge" BackgroundModeEnabled 0 Set-Dword "$pol\Edge" HideFirstRunExperience 1
foreach ($svc in 'DiagTrack', 'dmwappushservice') { Set-Dword "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$svc" Start 4 } foreach ($task in 'Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser', 'Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater', 'Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator', 'Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip', 'Feedback\Siuf\DmClient', 'Feedback\Siuf\DmClientOnScenarioDownload') { $path, $name = "\Microsoft\Windows\$(Split-Path $task)\", (Split-Path $task -Leaf) Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath $path -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Disable-ScheduledTask | Out-Null } # Stops Windows Update from pushing Outlook, Dev Home and Teams after setup. foreach ($key in 'OutlookUpdate', 'DevHomeUpdate', 'MS_Outlook', 'TeamsUpdate') { Remove-Item "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\Orchestrator\UScheduler_Oobe\$key" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# Dual boot with Arch: no auto device encryption, no Fast Startup or hibernate, clock in UTC. Set-Dword 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker' PreventDeviceEncryption 1 Set-Dword 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' HiberbootEnabled 0 powercfg /hibernate off powercfg /setactive 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c
# Default user profile: no OneDrive, no suggested or silently installed apps, dark theme, file extensions. reg load 'HKU\DefaultUser' "$env:SystemDrive\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT" | Out-Null reg delete 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' /v OneDriveSetup /f 2>$null | Out-Null $cdm = 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' foreach ($name in 'ContentDeliveryAllowed', 'OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'PreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled', 'SoftLandingEnabled', 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled', 'SubscribedContentEnabled', 'SubscribedContent-310093Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-338393Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled', 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled') { reg add $cdm /v $name /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null } $adv = 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' reg add $adv /v HideFileExt /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null reg add $adv /v Start_IrisRecommendations /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null $theme = 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' reg add $theme /v AppsUseLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null reg add $theme /v SystemUsesLightTheme /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null # First logon re-applies the light theme, so set dark mode again from RunOnce. $dark = 'reg add HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize /v {0} /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f' $runOnce = 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce' reg add $runOnce /v DarkApps /d ($dark -f 'AppsUseLightTheme') /f | Out-Null reg add $runOnce /v DarkSystem /d ($dark -f 'SystemUsesLightTheme') /f | Out-Null $cloud = 'HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' reg add $cloud /v DisableSpotlightCollectionOnDesktop /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null reg add $cloud /v DisableWindowsSpotlightFeatures /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null [gc]::Collect() reg unload 'HKU\DefaultUser' | Out-Null
Stop-Transcript
